reviews.title: Works Perfect for Wave 3, Plug and play easy mode
reviews.comment: Fit perfectly onto my mic arm and was the exact screw size for mounting my elgato wave 3. Took me less than 5 minutes to unbox and set up. This thing is heavy duty! My mic is not going anywhere. It's a tad bulky compared to the microphone itself without a pop filter. But you can move it any way you want. Over all way better than the stock mic holder i got from elgato easy 5 stars. If you're like me and sifted through and bunch of different similar looking holders, stop your search here, This is the one
reviews.author: Kyle Banks

reviews.title: High Quality, Good weight for the boom as well!
reviews.comment: This product is extremely well built and good for the price point. It fits perfectly with the boom arm from Elgato that I purchased. It has a very sleek look and was very easy to install. It functions as intended, as long as you make sure that you have the proper software for the mic itself as the Wave picks up a lot of sound. Highly recommended this shock mount!
reviews.author: Trevor Hall

reviews.title: Well Made
reviews.comment: Strong build, sturdy support and easy to setup on my mic arm.
reviews.author: Kyle

reviews.title: Not suggested to use with pop filter
reviews.comment: Good quality, but concerned it fits too tight to the pop filter, potentially introducing vibrations. If only the front was 2mm wider.

reviews.comment: I had an interesting interaction with the seller, and I think that though ultimately this purchase didn't work out for me, the follow up and the commitment to be a good seller was obvious, and I really appreciated that work and time when many others do not.
